title: Interrupt card
description: An interrupt card: a running agent pauses itself (ticket status in_progress -> interrupted) to ask the Founder a question mid-flight. The Founder answers by writing resume:<value>, where <value> is one of `options`. Store path: board/interrupts/<id>.json. Design-of-record: board/interrupts/README.md (DAS-1446). Consumer/runtime: DAS-1447.

question.description: Free-text prompt shown to the Founder.

options.description: Legal answers. The Founder's resume:<value> value must be one of these.

ticket.description: Id of the board/tickets/ ticket that raised the card.

payload.description: Arbitrary agent context needed to resume the work. May be empty ({}) but must be present.

created_by.description: Role key (from board/ROUTING.md) of the agent that raised the card.
